vocabulary.meaning_en: suitable for work; polite and serious
vocabulary.example: Can we keep our conversation professional, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: right or suitable for a situation
vocabulary.example: It's not appropriate to talk like that.

vocabulary.meaning_en: start talking about something different
vocabulary.example: Could we change the subject, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: about someone's private life
vocabulary.example: Questions about salary can feel too personal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: too private for the situation
vocabulary.example: He asked me questions that were too personal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: carefully, so that you do not upset people
vocabulary.example: She tactfully asked him to stop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being friendly and generous to guests
vocabulary.example: Thank you for your kind hospitality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: say things you should keep private
vocabulary.example: Sorry, have I said too much?

vocabulary.meaning_en: (of behaviour) not acceptable (informal, British)
vocabulary.example: His comment was out of order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wanting to do something very much; enthusiastic
vocabulary.example: She is keen to learn new skills.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make someone leave their job
vocabulary.example: The company won't fire anyone this year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what you achieve, for example sales numbers
vocabulary.example: His sales results have not been good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan to reach a goal
vocabulary.example: There's a lot to discuss about our new strategy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: talk about something in detail
vocabulary.example: We need to discuss the budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be in charge of a team or project
vocabulary.example: Anna is going to lead the new project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: help someone
vocabulary.example: Could you do me a favour and check this email?

vocabulary.meaning_en: says a lot but does little
vocabulary.example: Don't be all talk and no action. Show us results.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a clever person (informal)
vocabulary.example: She solved it quickly; she's a smart cookie.

vocabulary.meaning_en: learn how to do something
vocabulary.example: I'm getting the hang of the new system.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stop someone while they are speaking
vocabulary.example: Sorry to interrupt, but there's a call for you.

fine_lines.title: appropriate vs inappropriate
fine_lines.explanation_ar: appropriate لائق ومناسب، وinappropriate غير لائق. البادئة in- تعطي المعنى المعاكس.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Appropriate = suitable. Inappropriate = not suitable. The prefix in- makes the opposite.

examples.sentence: Wear appropriate clothes to the interview.
That joke was inappropriate at work.

fine_lines.title: personal vs professional
fine_lines.explanation_ar: personal عن الحياة الخاصة، وprofessional عن العمل وبأسلوب جاد ولائق.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Personal is about private life. Professional is about work, and polite and serious.

examples.sentence: I don't discuss personal matters at work.

expressions.phrase: It's not appropriate to talk like that.
expressions.meaning_ar: ليس من اللائق التحدث بهذه الطريقة.
expressions.meaning_en: Those words are not suitable here.
expressions.example: Please stop. It's not appropriate to talk like that about a colleague.

expressions.phrase: Could we change the subject, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا تغيير الموضوع من فضلك؟
expressions.example: I don't feel comfortable. Could we change the subject, please?

expressions.phrase: Can we keep our conversation professional, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا أن نُبقي حديثنا مهنيًّا من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Let's only talk about work matters.
expressions.example: Thank you, but can we keep our conversation professional, please?

expressions.phrase: I don't think it's appropriate to...
expressions.meaning_ar: لا أظن أنه من اللائق أن...
expressions.meaning_en: A softer way to say something is not suitable.
expressions.example: I don't think it's appropriate to discuss his salary.

expressions.phrase: Sorry, have I said too much?
expressions.meaning_ar: آسف، هل قلت أكثر مما ينبغي؟
expressions.meaning_en: Did I share too much private information?
expressions.example: Sorry, have I said too much? Let's talk about the project.

expressions.meaning_en: We have many things to talk about.
expressions.example: Let's start the meeting. There's a lot to discuss.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to start speaking while others talk.
expressions.example: Sorry to interrupt, but your taxi is here.

grammar.title: It's (not) appropriate to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم It's (not) appropriate to + فعل مجرد للحكم على ما إذا كان التصرف لائقًا. ولجعل العبارة ألطف نقول I don't think it's appropriate to...
grammar.explanation_en: Use It's (not) appropriate to + base verb to say if an action is suitable. To be softer: I don't think it's appropriate to...
examples: It's not appropriate to talk like that.
It's appropriate to wear a suit to the meeting.
I don't think it's appropriate to ask that.

grammar.title: Polite requests with Could we / Can we ... please?
grammar.explanation_ar: نطلب بلطف بصيغة سؤال: Could we / Can we + فعل مجرد ... please? وCould أكثر تهذيبًا من Can.
grammar.explanation_en: Make a polite request as a question: Could we / Can we + base verb ... please? Could is more polite than Can.
examples: Could we change the subject, please?
Can we keep this professional, please?
Could we talk about the plan, please?

questions.question: Which phrase politely stops a conversation that is too personal?
choices: Could we change the subject, please?
questions.explanation_ar: Could we change the subject, please? طريقة مهذبة لتغيير الموضوع.
questions.explanation_en: It is a polite way to move to a new topic.

questions.question: It's not ___ to talk like that.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد It's not نحتاج صفة: appropriate.

questions.question: The opposite of "appropriate" is...
questions.explanation_en: The opposite uses the prefix in-: inappropriate.

questions.question: Can we keep our conversation ___, please?
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج صفة بعد keep our conversation: professional.

questions.question: "Too personal" means...
questions.explanation_ar: too personal تعني خاصًا أكثر من اللازم للموقف.
questions.explanation_en: It means too private for the situation.

questions.question: Which is more polite?
choices: Could we change the subject, please?
questions.explanation_en: Could + please is the most polite.

questions.question: "All talk and no action" describes a person who...
choices: talks a lot but does little
questions.explanation_en: It means someone who talks a lot but does little.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: We need to discuss about the plan.
We need to discuss the plan.
We need to discussing the plan.
questions.explanation_ar: discuss لا يأتي بعده about، وبعد need to فعل مجرد.
questions.explanation_en: Discuss takes no 'about'; use need to + base verb.

questions.question: "Fire" (at work) means...
questions.explanation_ar: fire في سياق العمل تعني يفصل من العمل.
questions.explanation_en: At work, fire means make someone lose their job.

questions.question: Anna did Tom a ___ by helping him.
questions.explanation_ar: do someone a favour تعني يُسدي معروفًا.
questions.explanation_en: Do someone a favour = help someone.
